# Example Site

> The crawl-misconfig fixture. Every link below is an absolute HTTPS URL, which is
> what the llms.txt checks require, so this file is a control rather than a defect.

## Pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): what the fixture is for.
- [Guides](https://example.com/guides/): the index of written guides.
- [Crawl directives](https://example.com/guides/crawl-directives/): the one guide.
- [About](https://example.com/about/): who maintains the fixture.
